name: RAG-Benchmark-in-LIB
description:
Battery Thermal Safety RAG Benchmark
	

This dataset is a domain-specific RAG benchmark for evaluating retrieval-augmented
question answering systems in the lithium-ion battery thermal safety domain.

	
		
		Contents
	


3,000+ curated QA pairs from battery safety literature, standards, and reports.
Each query includes:
Question
Ground truth Answer
Positive context chunk(s)
Negative distractor chunks
Metadata (source, section, chunk_id)
